last_run: Close Call: your own record. After 5 graded answers, 'Your answers' shows how often you were right next to how often the market's odds expected you to be (a 90% favourite being right says little), and only calls you ahead or behind after 5 closing days and past what luck explains. Each answer line shows the market's odds for your side and the closing price.
next: Check the brain's record and the new 'your record' box after the first grades on Nov 19.

replies.body: Close Call now shows each user their own record against the market's odds: 'You were right 7 of 14; the market's odds expected 6.7', with an honest skill-or-luck line. Each answer also shows the odds the market gave it.
